name: @sdid/mobile
description: Citizen mobile authenticator for the SDID Auth Bridge (spec 05). src/core is plain TypeScript and runs under vitest; src/ui and src/native/*.rn.ts need a React Native toolchain (see README).
comment:react-native-dependencies: The React Native / Expo dependency set this app needs is deliberately NOT
installed in this monorepo and NOT listed above. Adding it here would break
`pnpm --filter @sdid/mobile typecheck|test` for everyone until a full native
toolchain exists. The exact package list, versions and rationale live in
docs/rn-dependencies.md; the README explains the split.
